## Type of change

- [ ] Catalog addition — new SAP service(s) added to `sap_service_catalog.json`

## Checklist

- [ ] Tested locally with `npm run dev` (at least one sketch or Mermaid conversion)
- [ ] Catalog entries include `id`, `name`, `category`, `aliases`, `drawio`, and `cap`
- [ ] `icon_id` provided for any new catalog entry (find IDs in `data/sap_icon_index.json`)
- [ ] No `.env` or API keys committed
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-catalog.js` passes locally
